milestones.name: AI Engineering System + Repository Foundation
milestones.objective: Make the repository self-coordinating, buildable, and ready for parallel agents.

milestones.name: Core Discovery Experience
milestones.objective: Deliver typed catalog, search, title details, and a coherent user-facing discovery flow.

milestones.name: Media Resolution + Provider Foundation
milestones.objective: Build deterministic stream/audio/subtitle/failover policy and authorized provider boundaries.

milestones.name: Identity + Personal State
milestones.objective: Add authentication, profiles, progress, and watchlist persistence.

milestones.name: Playback Vertical Slice
milestones.objective: Resolve an authorized source, play it through an explicit state machine, and record progress/telemetry.

milestones.name: Live + Intelligence Boundaries
milestones.objective: Prepare live-TV contracts and initial explainable recommendations while external provider work remains rights-gated.

milestones.name: Shared-Agent Automation Bridge
milestones.objective: Move cross-agent collaboration from manual handoffs toward GitHub-backed and optional API-driven dispatch.

milestones.name: External Licensed Integrations
milestones.objective: Integrate production media/live providers only after licensing and credentials are approved.
